verses.text: Dis na revelation of di word of di Lord to Israel through Malachi.
“I don love una,” na so di Lord talk. But una talk say, “How you love us?” “Esau no be Jacob brother?” na so di Lord talk, “Yet I love Jacob;”
“But Esau I hate, and make im mountains desolation, and give im heritage to di jackals of di wilderness.”

Edom dey talk say, “Dem don beat us down, but we go return and build di waste places;” di Lord of Armies talk say, “Dem fit build, but I go throw down; and men go call dem Di Wicked Land, and Di People wey di Lord Dey Show Wrath Against Forever.”
Your eyes go see am, and una go talk say, “Di Lord dey great — even beyond di border of Israel!”

“Pikin dey honor im papa, and servant im master. If den I be Father, wia my honor dey? And if I be master, wia di respect wey suppose dey for me dey?” na so di Lord of Armies talk to una, priests, wey dey despise my name. Una talk say, “How we despise your name?”
Una dey offer polluted bread for my altar. Una talk say, “How we pollute you?” Because una talk say, “Di Lord table dey contemptible.”

“When una offer di blind for sacrifice, e no be evil? And when una offer di lame and sick, e no be evil? Present am now to your governor! E go dey pleased with una? Or e go accept your person?” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“Now, I beg una, entreat di favor of God, so that e go dey gracious to us. Dis one don come from your hand: e go accept any of una?” na so di Lord of Armies talk.

“I wish say somebody dey among una wey go shut di doors, so that una no go kindle fire on my altar for nothing! I no get pleasure for una,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “and I no go accept offering from your hand.”

“Because from di rising of di sun even reach di going down, my name go great among di nations, and for every place dem go offer incense to my name, and pure offering; because my name go great among di nations,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“But una dey profane am when una talk say, ‘Di Lord table dey polluted, and im fruit, even im food, dey contemptible.’”

“Una talk too, ‘Look, how e dey tire us!’ And una don sniff at am,” na so di Lord of Armies talk; “and una don bring wetin dem take by violence, and di lame, and di sick; so una dey bring di offering. I suppose accept dis from your hand?” na so di Lord talk.

“But cursed be di deceiver wey get male for im flock, and make vow, and sacrifice to Lord blemished thing; because I na great King,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “and my name dey awesome among di nations.”
“Now so, una priests, dis commandment na for una.”

“If una no go listen, and if una no go take am to heart, to give glory to my name,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “den I go send di curse on una, and I go curse your blessings. Yes, I don curse dem already, because una no take am to heart.”
“Look, I go rebuke una seed, and spread dung on una faces, even di dung of una feasts; and dem go carry una away with am.”
“Una go know say I don send dis commandment to una, so that my covenant go dey with Levi,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“My covenant dey with am of life and peace; and I give dem to am so that e go fear; and e fear me, and e stand in awe of my name.”
“Di law of truth dey for im mouth, and unrighteousness no dey found for im lips. E walk with me in peace and uprightness, and turn plenty away from iniquity.”
“Because di priest lips suppose keep knowledge, and dem suppose seek di law from im mouth; because e na di messenger of di Lord of Armies.”
“But una don turn away from di way. Una don make plenty stumble for di law. Una don corrupt di covenant of Levi,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“So I don also make una contemptible and base before all di people, according to di way wey una no keep my ways, but una show partiality for di law.”
We no all get one papa? One God no create us? Why we dey deal treacherously every man against im brother, dey profane di covenant of our papa dem?
Judah don deal treacherously, and abomination dey commit for Israel and for Jerusalem; because Judah don profane di holiness of di Lord wey e love, and don marry di daughter of foreign god.
Di Lord go cut off di man wey do dis, di one wey dey wake and di one wey dey answer, from di tents of Jacob, and di one wey offer offering to di Lord of Armies.
Dis again una dey do: una dey cover di Lord altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because e no dey regard di offering again, and e no dey receive am with good will from your hand.
Yet una talk say, “Why?” Because di Lord don be witness between you and di wife of your youth, wey you don deal treacherously against, even though na your companion, and di wife of your covenant.
Di Lord no make one, even though e get di residue of di Spirit? Why one? E seek godly seed. So take heed to your spirit, and make nobody deal treacherously against di wife of im youth.

“Because I hate divorce,” na so di Lord, di God of Israel, talk, “and di one wey cover im garment with violence,” na so di Lord of Armies talk. “So take heed to your spirit, so that una no go deal treacherously.”

Una don tire di Lord with una words. Yet una talk say, “How we tire am?” Because una talk say, “Everyone wey dey do evil dey good for di sight of di Lord, and e dey delight for dem;” or “Wia di God of justice dey?”

“Look, I dey send my messenger, and e go prepare di way before me; and Lord, wey una dey seek, go suddenly come to im temple; and di messenger of di covenant, wey una desire, look, e dey come!” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“But who fit endure di day of im coming? And who go stand when e appear? Because e dey like refiner fire, and like launderers soap;”
“And e go sit like refiner and purifier of silver, and e go purify di sons of Levi, and refine dem like gold and silver; and dem go offer to di Lord offerings for righteousness.”
“Den di offering of Judah and Jerusalem go dey pleasant to di Lord, as for di days of old, and as for ancient years.”

“I go come near to una for judgment; and I go be swift witness against di sorcerers, and against di adulterers, and against di perjurers, and against dem wey oppress di hireling for im wages, di widow, and di fatherless, and wey deprive di foreigner of im right, and no fear me,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“Because I, di Lord, no dey change; so una, sons of Jacob, no don finish.”
“From di days of una papa dem una don turn aside from my ordinances, and no keep dem. Return to me, and I go return to una,” na so di Lord of Armies talk. “But una talk say, ‘How we go return?’”
“Man go rob God? Yet una dey rob me! But una talk say, ‘How we don rob you?’ For tithes and offerings.”
“Una dey cursed with di curse; because una dey rob me, even dis whole nation.”

“Bring all di tithes enter di storehouse, so that food go dey for my house, and test me now with dis,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “if I no go open di windows of heaven for una, and pour out blessing for una, so that enough room no go dey to receive am.”
“I go rebuke di devourer because of una, and e no go destroy di fruits of your ground; and your vine no go drop im fruit before im time for di field,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“All nations go call una blessed; because una go be delightful land,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“Una words don dey harsh against me,” na so di Lord talk. “Yet una talk say, ‘Wetin we talk against you?’”
“Una don talk say, ‘E dey vain to serve God. Wetin profit e get say we don keep im ordinance, and say we don walk mournfully before di Lord of Armies?’”
“‘Now we dey call di proud happy; yes, dem wey dey work wickedness dey build up; yes, dem dey tempt God, and escape.’”
Den dem wey fear di Lord talk to one another; and di Lord listen, and hear, and dem write book of remembrance before am, for dem wey fear di Lord, and wey honor im name.
“Dem go be mine,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “my own possession for di day wey I make. I go spare dem, as man dey spare im own pikin wey dey serve am.”
Den una go again see di difference between di righteous and di wicked, between di one wey dey serve God and di one wey no dey serve am.

“Because look, di day dey come, burning like furnace, when all di proud, and all wey dey work wickedness, go be stubble. Di day wey dey come go burn dem up,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “so that e no go leave dem root or branch.”
“But to una wey fear my name, di sun of righteousness go rise with healing for im wings. Una go come out, and leap like calves of di stall.”
“Una go tread down di wicked; because dem go be ashes under di soles of una feet for di day wey I make,” na so di Lord of Armies talk.
“Remember di law of Moses my servant, wey I command am for Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.”
“Look, I go send una Elijah di prophet before di great and terrible day of di Lord come.”
“E go turn di hearts of di papa dem to di pikin dem, and di hearts of di pikin dem to dem papa dem, so that I no go come and strike di earth with curse.”
